displayName: Access Token Manipulation: Parent PID Spoofing

tests.name: Parent PID Spoofing using PowerShell
tests.description:
This test uses PowerShell to replicates how Cobalt Strike does ppid spoofing and masquerade a spawned process.
Upon execution, "Process C:\Program Files\Internet Explorer\iexplore.exe is spawned with pid ####" will be displayed and
calc.exe will be launched.

Credit to In Ming Loh (https://github.com/countercept/ppid-spoofing/blob/master/PPID-Spoof.ps1)

tests.name: Parent PID Spoofing - Spawn from Current Process
tests.description: Spawns a powershell.exe process as a child of the current process.

tests.name: Parent PID Spoofing - Spawn from Specified Process
tests.description: Spawns a notepad.exe process as a child of the current process.

tests.name: Parent PID Spoofing - Spawn from svchost.exe
tests.description: Spawnd a process as a child of the first accessible svchost.exe process.

tests.name: Parent PID Spoofing - Spawn from New Process
tests.description: Creates a notepad.exe process and then spawns a powershell.exe process as a child of it.
